_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Small pure-C# utility mod (19 tracked files, no card JSON), so 4 modules following the code's responsibilities rather than 5-15. Localization CSVs name no card, so their rows attribute to the mod-wide module. `module_map.py check QuickTransfer` must exit 0.

modules.name: Batch Transfer
modules.summary: QuickTransferPatch (the click-to-move batch transfer) and BatchContext, the live SwapCard destination state it drives.

modules.name: Container Settings and Last Batch
modules.summary: Per-container settings keyed on the open container's UniqueID, and BatchRecord, the newest batch's moved cards.

modules.name: Cross-mod Bridges
modules.summary: RepeatActionBridge (stepping aside from Repeat Action's count keys) and UtilityBeltLockBridge (skipping cards Utility Belt has locked).

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry and config (keys, mouse buttons), the overlay strings, project files and docs.
